# scm_dlp_forward_profile (Resource)

> **Beta / Experimental:** Enterprise DLP support (`scm_dlp_*`) in `terraform-provider-scm` is currently in **Beta / Experimental** and subject to schema or behavior changes.

[Beta / Experimental] Manages an Enterprise DLP Forward Profile.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Forward DLP incident logs from selected regions.
resource "scm_dlp_forward_profile" "us_eu" {
  name    = "US-EU-Forwarding"
  enabled = true
  regions = ["us", "eu"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the forward profile is enabled.
- `name` (String) The name of the forward profile.

### Optional

- `regions` (List of String) List of regions to filter forwarded logs (e.g. us, eu, ap, etc.).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the forward profile.
- `tfid` (String) The Terraform ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing DLP forward profile by its ID.
terraform import scm_dlp_forward_profile.example <id>
```
